title: Plasmid Protocol Builder
description: A command-line tool that builds bench-protocol workbooks for HiFi assembly and Golden Gate (GGA) assembly from a design table, given as a CSV file or as one block of a project workbook. The rows are written to the Data sheet of an Excel template whose other sheets are formulas: restriction digestion, PCR, assembly mix, oligo annealing, ligation mix and transformation. Reagent volumes and conditions are documented and meant to be edited.
